cases.sentence: Воистину знаю, что это так, но будет ли смертный перед ___ прав?
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before, in front of) requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Если бы он захотел с ним спорить, не смог бы ответить ни на один из тысячи ___
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of, from among) requires the genitive case.
The preposition без (without) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он солнцу велит, и оно не светит, печатью он заключает ___
cases.explain: The verb заключает (seals) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Он один простирает ___ и попирает волны морские
cases.explain: The verb простирает (stretches) requires the accusative case; небеса is the accusative plural form.

cases.sentence: Как же мне спорить с ним? Где найти ___, чтобы ему возразить?
cases.explain: The verb найти (to find) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Если в силе дело, то он могуч, а если в ___, то кто приведет его на суд?
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) when indicating location or state requires the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Воистину знаю, что это так, но будет ли смертный перед Богом прав?
reading.question: What is Job's central dilemma when he considers God's justice?
options: How can man be just before God?
When will God answer my prayers?
How can I prove my innocence?
reading.correct: How can man be just before God?
reading.explain: Job acknowledges that God is just, but questions how a mortal man could ever argue his case before God.

reading.ru: Он передвигает горы без ведома людей, и в своем гневе рушит их
reading.question: What does God do when angered according to this passage?
options: He overturns mountains without anyone knowing and overthrows them in His wrath
He speaks gently to the earth
reading.correct: He overturns mountains without anyone knowing and overthrows them in His wrath
reading.explain: Job describes God's power and anger—He moves mountains without human knowledge and destroys them in His fury.

reading.ru: Он солнцу велит, и оно не светит, печатью он заключает звезды
reading.question: What cosmic powers does God exercise according to Job?
options: He commands the sun not to shine and seals up the stars
He creates the sun and stars
He makes the stars move backwards
He stops all light in the world
reading.correct: He commands the sun not to shine and seals up the stars
reading.explain: Job illustrates God's absolute control over creation—He can command the sun to cease shining and seal up the stars.

reading.ru: Вот Он пройдет передо мной, а я Его не увижу, пронесется мимо, а я Его не замечу
reading.question: What does Job say about his ability to perceive God's presence?
options: God may pass before him and he would not see Him; He goes by and he does not perceive it
He can always see God clearly
God walks slowly so he can follow Him
reading.correct: God may pass before him and he would not see Him; He goes by and he does not perceive it
reading.explain: Job emphasizes his human limitation—God may pass right by him, but Job is unable to see or perceive Him.

reading.ru: Как же мне спорить с ним? Где найти слова, чтобы ему возразить?
reading.question: What does Job realize about his ability to argue with God?
options: He cannot find words to contend with God
He is more eloquent than God
reading.correct: He cannot find words to contend with God
reading.explain: Job despairs of finding any words sufficient to mount an argument against the Almighty.

reading.ru: Даже если вымоюсь снеговой водой, руки отмоюсь щелоком, то и тогда ты погрузишь меня в грязь
reading.question: What does Job say will happen even if he cleanses himself thoroughly?
options: Even if he washes with snow water and cleanses his hands with lye, God will plunge him into filth
He will become pure and clean
God will be pleased with him
reading.correct: Even if he washes with snow water and cleanses his hands with lye, God will plunge him into filth
reading.explain: Job expresses the hopelessness of his situation—no amount of self-purification will help, for God will condemn him regardless.
